name: Yoav Tzfati
headline: Builds Alignment Hive: shared tooling, training, and knowledge for AI alignment researchers
bio: Yoav Tzfati runs Alignment Hive, a shared tooling and knowledge layer for the third-party alignment research community. As soft takeoff picks up, the aim is to give independent researchers and small orgs the benefits of scale that frontier AI labs have: curated tools, training, and aggregated knowledge and data. The uplift work is hands-on: talks and workshops on where reliable agent delegation stands today, and 1:1 sessions with researchers applied to their own projects. Dozens of researchers across MATS, Far Labs, and other AI safety organizations have used the tools or sessions. The tools are open source and shaped by concrete bottlenecks in real research work. Background: MATS alum (scalable oversight with NYU's Alignment Research Group, then the Security Level 5 task force). Previously taught Claude Code at Code Bloom and helped build and teach the Arbor trading bootcamp.
